pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Kentucky GPA

officialLinks.label: Grading scale, exclusions, Pass/Fail, repeat policy
Official GPA calculator and quality-hour formula

helpIntro: The University of Kentucky standard undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, and F/E=0. Enter UK credit hours and final grades to estimate current and projected GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate grading under the policy effective August 23, 2026. Pass/Fail and transfer grades are excluded. Law, graduate/professional and other alternate grading systems need separate review. Repeat Impact is disabled because UK now uses the highest completed grade under its repeat option.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 quality points and a 3-credit B earns 9. Together, 21 ÷ 6 = 3.5.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 quality point per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F contributes zero grade points while the course remains GPA-bearing.
gradeExplanations.E: E is a zero-point failure; UK says it will stop being issued in Fall 2027.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.CR: CR credit is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IP: IP is excluded while work is in progress.
gradeExplanations.N: N is a temporary non-GPA mark.
gradeExplanations.XE: XE is a zero-point failure and cannot use the repeat option.

specialTypes.name: UK course, standard letter grading
specialTypes.note: Use for standard UK undergraduate A/B/C/D/F/E grading.

specialTypes.name: UK course, Pass/Fail grading
specialTypes.note: P and F on the Pass/Fail track are excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer grades do not enter the UK GPA.

specialTypes.name: Law, graduate, professional, or alternate grading system
specialTypes.note: These contexts can use different grade symbols, grade points, or repeat rules; use the applicable program record.

repeatPolicy.note: UK repeat rules can exclude lower completed attempts after you exercise the repeat option, but the calculator does not automate this 2026 highest-grade rule. Use your official Q HRS/Q PTS after repeat processing or confirm with your advisor/Registrar.
